0.content: # ✅ Observability Health Report (v10 - Selector-Driven Tier 1 Support)

16.query:
load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"
| fieldsAdd cmdb_ci_key, appname = name
| lookup [load "/lookups/cmdb_server"], sourceField:cmdb_ci_key, lookupField:busapp_cmdb_ci_key, fields:{cmdbhostname = name, server_fqdn = fully_qualified_domain_name}
| filter isNotNull(name)
| lookup [
fetch dt.entity.host
| fields id, entity.name,  monitoringMode, paasVendorType, isMonitoringCandidate, awsNameTag
| fieldsAdd monitoringMode = if(isNotNull(paasVendorType), "APP_ONLY", else:if(isMonitoringCandidate == true, "CANDIDATE", else:monitoringMode))
| fieldsRemove paasVendorType, awsNameTag, isMonitoringCandidate
| parse entity.name, """LD:hostname ('.' LD:domain)? EOS"""
| limit 20000], sourceField:cmdbhostname, lookupField:hostname, fields:{id, hostname, monitoringMode}
| filter isNotNull(hostname)
| summarize `Total Applications` = count()
16.title: Total Applications in Dynatrace

17.title: CMDB Apps By Tier

18.query:
load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"
| fields
    app_key = cmdb_ci_key,
    `Application` = name,
    `Tier` = business_criticality,
    `Status` = dv_operational_status,
    `Owner` = owned_by,
    `RUM Domains` = rum_domains,
    business_unit = dv_business_unit
| filter in(`Application`, array($ApplicationName))
| filter in(`Tier`, array($Tier))
| filter in(`Status`, array($Status))
| filter in(business_unit, array($BusinessUnit))
| sort `Application` asc
18.title: Application Observability Overview (Click to Select)

19.query:
fetch dt.entity.host
| fieldsAdd host_name = entity.name
| fields id, entity.name,  monitoringMode, paasVendorType, isMonitoringCandidate, awsNameTag
| fieldsAdd monitoringMode = if(isNotNull(paasVendorType), "APP_ONLY", else:if(isMonitoringCandidate == true, "CANDIDATE", else:monitoringMode))
| parse entity.name, """LD:hostname ('.' LD:domain)? EOS"""
| lookup [ load "/lookups/cmdb_server"], sourcefield:hostname, lookupfield:name, fields:{server_fqdn = fully_qualified_domain_name, cmdb_ci_key}
| fieldsRemove paasVendorType, awsNameTag, isMonitoringCandidate
| fieldsAdd isInCMDB = if(isNull(cmdb_ci_key), "NOT FOUND IN CMDB", else:"FOUND IN CMDB")
| filterOut isInCMDB == "NOT FOUND IN CMDB" 
| filterOut monitoringMode == "CANDIDATE"
| limit 20000
| summarize `Monitored Servers` = count()
19.title: Servers Monitored by Dynatrace

20.title: Applications Not in Dynatrace

22.query:
load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"
| filter in(`name`, array($SelectedApplication))
| fieldsAdd app_key = cmdb_ci_key, `Application` = name
| lookup [
    load "/lookups/cmdb_server"
    | fields app_key = busapp_cmdb_ci_key, server_name = name, server_location = location
    | fieldsAdd server_name_lower = lower(server_name)
    | lookup [
        fetch dt.entity.host
        | fields id, entity.name, monitoringMode, paasVendorType, isMonitoringCandidate, installerVersion
        | fieldsAdd monitoringMode = if(isNotNull(paasVendorType), then:"APP_ONLY", else:if(isMonitoringCandidate == true, then:"CANDIDATE", else:monitoringMode))
        | parse entity.name, """LD:hostname ('.' LD:domain)? EOS"""
        | fieldsAdd server_name_lower = lower(hostname)
        | lookup [
            fetch logs
            | summarize logCount = count(), by:{host_id = dt.entity.host}
          ], sourceField:id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{logCount}
        | lookup [
            fetch spans
            | summarize spanCount = count(), by:{host_id = dt.entity.host}
          ], sourceField:id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{spanCount}
        | lookup [
            timeseries cpu = avg(dt.host.cpu.usage), by:{host_id = dt.entity.host}
            | fieldsAdd metricEvidence = if(arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(cpu)) > 0, then:1, else:0)
            | fields host_id, metricEvidence
          ], sourceField:id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{metricEvidence}
        | summarize
            hostMatch = max(if(isNotNull(id), then:1, else:0)),
            fullStackCount = sum(if(monitoringMode == "FULL_STACK", then:1, else:0)),
            infraCount = sum(if(monitoringMode == "INFRASTRUCTURE", then:1, else:0)),
            appOnlyCount = sum(if(monitoringMode == "APP_ONLY", then:1, else:0)),
            discoveryCount = sum(if(monitoringMode == "DISCOVERY", then:1, else:0)),
            traceEvidence = max(if(isNotNull(spanCount) AND spanCount > 0, then:1, else:0)),
            metricEvidence = max(coalesce(metricEvidence, 0)),
            logEvidence = max(if(isNotNull(logCount) AND logCount > 0, then:1, else:0)),
            by:{server_name_lower}
      ], sourceField:server_name_lower, lookupField:server_name_lower, fields:{hostMatch, fullStackCount, infraCount, appOnlyCount, discoveryCount, traceEvidence, metricEvidence, logEvidence}
  ], sourceField:app_key, lookupField:app_key, fields:{server_name, server_location, hostMatch, fullStackCount, infraCount, appOnlyCount, discoveryCount, traceEvidence, metricEvidence, logEvidence}
| fieldsAdd
    hostMatch = coalesce(hostMatch, 0),
    fullStackCount = coalesce(fullStackCount, 0),
    infraCount = coalesce(infraCount, 0),
    appOnlyCount = coalesce(appOnlyCount, 0),
    discoveryCount = coalesce(discoveryCount, 0),
    traceEvidence = coalesce(traceEvidence, 0),
    metricEvidence = coalesce(metricEvidence, 0),
    logEvidence = coalesce(logEvidence, 0)
| fieldsAdd
    `Dynatrace Match` = if(hostMatch > 0, then:"✅", else:"❌"),
    `Mode Detail` = if(hostMatch == 0, then:"Missing", else:if(fullStackCount > 0 AND infraCount == 0 AND appOnlyCount == 0 AND discoveryCount == 0, then:"Full Stack", else:if(infraCount > 0 AND fullStackCount == 0 AND appOnlyCount == 0 AND discoveryCount == 0, then:"Infrastructure", else:if(appOnlyCount > 0 AND fullStackCount == 0 AND infraCount == 0 AND discoveryCount == 0, then:"App Only", else:if(discoveryCount > 0 AND fullStackCount == 0 AND infraCount == 0 AND appOnlyCount == 0, then:"Discovery", else:"Mixed"))))),
    Traces = if(traceEvidence == 1, then:"✅", else:if(hostMatch == 1, then:"❌", else:"❌")),
    Metrics = if(metricEvidence == 1, then:"✅", else:if(hostMatch == 1, then:"❌", else:"❌")),
    Logs = if(logEvidence == 1, then:"✅", else:if(hostMatch == 1, then:"❌", else:"❌")),
    `Server Quality` = if(hostMatch == 0, then:"Missing", else:if(traceEvidence == 1 AND metricEvidence == 1 AND logEvidence == 1, then:"Complete", else:"Weak Signals"))
| fieldsAdd ServerQualityRank = if(`Server Quality` == "Missing", then:3, else:if(`Server Quality` == "Weak Signals", then:2, else:1))
| filter in(`Application`, array($ApplicationName))
| filter in(server_location, array($Location))
| sort ServerQualityRank desc, server_name asc
| fields `Application`, `Server` = server_name, `Location` = server_location, `Dynatrace Match`, `Mode Detail`, Traces, Metrics, Logs, `Server Quality`
22.title: Server Coverage Drilldown (Selected App)

23.query:
load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"
| filter in(`name`, array($SelectedApplication))
| fieldsAdd app_key = cmdb_ci_key, `Application` = name
| lookup [
    load "/lookups/cmdb_server"
    | fields app_key = busapp_cmdb_ci_key, server_name = name
    | fieldsAdd server_name_lower = lower(server_name)
    | lookup [
        fetch dt.entity.host
        | fields id, entity.name, monitoringMode, paasVendorType, isMonitoringCandidate
        | fieldsAdd monitoringMode = if(isNotNull(paasVendorType), then:"APP_ONLY", else:if(isMonitoringCandidate == true, then:"CANDIDATE", else:monitoringMode))
        | parse entity.name, """LD:hostname ('.' LD:domain)? EOS"""
        | fieldsAdd server_name_lower = lower(hostname)
        | fields server_name_lower, monitoringMode
      ], sourceField:server_name_lower, lookupField:server_name_lower, fields:{monitoringMode}
  ], sourceField:app_key, lookupField:app_key, fields:{server_name, monitoringMode}
| fieldsAdd monitoringMode = coalesce(monitoringMode, "Not Monitored")
| filter in(`Application`, array($ApplicationName))
| summarize `Server Count` = count(), by:{`Application`, `Monitoring Mode` = monitoringMode}
| sort `Application` asc, `Monitoring Mode` asc
23.title: Monitoring Modes Breakdown (Selected App)

24.title: Observability Evidence by Server (Selected App)

25.query:
load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"
| filter in(`name`, array($SelectedApplication))
| fieldsAdd app_key = cmdb_ci_key, app_short_name_lower = lower(short_name)
| lookup [
    load "/lookups/cmdb_server"
    | fields app_key = busapp_cmdb_ci_key, server_name = name
    | fieldsAdd server_name_lower = lower(server_name)
    | lookup [
        fetch dt.entity.host
        | fields id, entity.name, tags
        | parse entity.name, """LD:hostname ('.' LD:domain)? EOS"""
        | fieldsAdd server_name_lower = lower(hostname)
        | fields id, server_name_lower
      ], sourceField:server_name_lower, lookupField:server_name_lower, fields:{id}
  ], sourceField:app_key, lookupField:app_key, fields:{server_name, id}
| lookup [
    fetch dt.davis.problems
    | filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) AND event.status == "ACTIVE"
    | expand affected_entity_id = affected_entity_ids
    | filter matchesPhrase(affected_entity_id, "HOST-")
    | summarize problem_count = countDistinct(display_id), by:{host_id = affected_entity_id}
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{problem_count}
| fieldsAdd problem_count = coalesce(problem_count, 0)
| filter in(`Application`, array($ApplicationName))
| filter problem_count > 0
| fields `Application`, `Server` = server_name, `Active Problems` = problem_count
| sort `Active Problems` desc, `Server` asc
25.title: Active Problems (Selected App)

26.query:
load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"
| filter in(`name`, array($SelectedApplication))
| fields 
    `Application` = name, 
    cmdb_ci_key,
    rum_expected = rum_expected,
    rum_domains
| lookup [
    load "/lookups/cmdb_app_frontend_mapping"
    | fields
        app_key = app_cmdb_ci_key,
        frontend_entity_id,
        frontend_name,
        user_event_count_24h,
        session_count_24h,
        last_seen_user_event,
        mapping_confidence,
        mapping_method
    | fieldsAdd
        user_event_count_24h = toLong(coalesce(user_event_count_24h, 0)),
        session_count_24h = toLong(coalesce(session_count_24h, 0))
    | summarize
        mapped_frontends = countDistinct(frontend_entity_id),
        rum_user_events_24h = sum(user_event_count_24h),
        rum_sessions_24h = sum(session_count_24h),
        rum_last_seen = max(last_seen_user_event),
        rum_mapping_confidence = takeFirst(mapping_confidence),
        rum_mapping_method = takeFirst(mapping_method),
        by:{app_key}
  ], sourceField:cmdb_ci_key, lookupField:app_key, fields:{mapped_frontends, rum_user_events_24h, rum_sessions_24h, rum_last_seen, rum_mapping_confidence, rum_mapping_method}
| fieldsAdd
    mapped_frontends = coalesce(mapped_frontends, 0),
    rum_user_events_24h = coalesce(rum_user_events_24h, 0),
    rum_sessions_24h = coalesce(rum_sessions_24h, 0),
    rum_mapping_confidence = coalesce(rum_mapping_confidence, "none"),
    rum_mapping_method = coalesce(rum_mapping_method, "none")
| fieldsAdd
    `RUM Expected` = coalesce(rum_expected, "No"),
    `RUM Status` = if(toLong(coalesce(rum_expected, 0)) == 0, then:"N/A", else:if(mapped_frontends == 0, then:"Not Mapped", else:"Mapped")),
    `Mapped Frontends` = toString(mapped_frontends),
    `User Events (24h)` = toString(rum_user_events_24h),
    `Sessions (24h)` = toString(rum_sessions_24h),
    `Mapping Method` = rum_mapping_method,
    `Mapping Confidence` = rum_mapping_confidence,
    `RUM Domains` = coalesce(rum_domains, "N/A")
| filter in(`Application`, array($ApplicationName))
| fields `Application`, `RUM Expected`, `RUM Status`, `Mapped Frontends`, `User Events (24h)`, `Sessions (24h)`, `Mapping Method`, `Mapping Confidence`, `RUM Domains`
26.title: RUM/Frontend Mappings (Selected App)

27.query:
load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"
| filter in(`name`, array($SelectedApplication))
| fieldsAdd app_key = cmdb_ci_key, `Application` = name
| lookup [
    load "/lookups/cmdb_server"
    | fields app_key = busapp_cmdb_ci_key, server_name = name
    | fieldsAdd server_name_lower = lower(server_name)
    | lookup [
        fetch dt.entity.host
        | fields id, entity.name
        | parse entity.name, """LD:hostname ('.' LD:domain)? EOS"""
        | fieldsAdd server_name_lower = lower(hostname)
        | fields id, server_name_lower
      ], sourceField:server_name_lower, lookupField:server_name_lower, fields:{id}
  ], sourceField:app_key, lookupField:app_key, fields:{server_name, id}
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.vulnerability
    | summarize 
        critical_count = countDistinct(if(severity == "CRITICAL", display_id), default:0),
        high_count = countDistinct(if(severity == "HIGH", display_id), default:0),
        medium_count = countDistinct(if(severity == "MEDIUM", display_id), default:0),
        low_count = countDistinct(if(severity == "LOW", display_id), default:0),
        by:{host_id = dt.entity.host}
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{critical_count, high_count, medium_count, low_count}
| fieldsAdd
    critical_count = coalesce(critical_count, 0),
    high_count = coalesce(high_count, 0),
    medium_count = coalesce(medium_count, 0),
    low_count = coalesce(low_count, 0),
    total_vulns = critical_count + high_count + medium_count + low_count
| filter in(`Application`, array($ApplicationName))
| filter total_vulns > 0
| fields `Application`, `Hostname` = server_name, Critical = critical_count, High = high_count, Medium = medium_count, Low = low_count, `Total Vulnerabilities` = total_vulns
| sort Critical desc, High desc, `Hostname` asc
27.title: Hosts + Vulnerability Counts (Selected App)

28.title: Co-Located Services (Selected App)

29.query:
load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"
| filter in(`name`, array($SelectedApplication))
| fieldsAdd app_key = cmdb_ci_key
| lookup [
    load "/lookups/cmdb_server"
    | fields app_key = busapp_cmdb_ci_key, server_name = name
    | fieldsAdd server_name_lower = lower(server_name)
    | lookup [
        fetch dt.entity.host
        | fields id, entity.name
        | parse entity.name, """LD:hostname ('.' LD:domain)? EOS"""
        | fieldsAdd server_name_lower = lower(hostname)
        | fields id, server_name_lower
      ], sourceField:server_name_lower, lookupField:server_name_lower, fields:{id}
  ], sourceField:app_key, lookupField:app_key, fields:{server_name, id}
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.service
    | fields service_id = id, host_id = dt.entity.host
    | filter isNotNull(host_id)
    | lookup [
        timeseries
            error_rate_pct = (sum(dt.service.request.count.server, filter: in(span.status, {"ERROR"})) / sum(dt.service.request.count.server)) * 100,
            p95_latency_ms = percentile(dt.service.response_time, 95),
            request_count = sum(dt.service.request.count.server),
            by:{service_id}
      ], sourceField:service_id, lookupField:service_id, fields:{error_rate_pct, p95_latency_ms, request_count}
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{error_rate_pct, p95_latency_ms, request_count}
| filter in(`Application`, array($ApplicationName))
| fieldsAdd
    error_rate_pct = coalesce(error_rate_pct, 0),
    p95_latency_ms = coalesce(p95_latency_ms, 0),
    request_count = coalesce(request_count, 0)
| summarize
    avg_error_rate = round(avg(error_rate_pct), 2),
    max_p95_latency = round(max(p95_latency_ms), 0),
    total_requests = sum(request_count)
| fieldsAdd
    `Avg Error Rate %` = avg_error_rate,
    `Max P95 Latency (ms)` = max_p95_latency,
    `Total Requests (24h)` = toString(toLong(total_requests))
| fields `Avg Error Rate %`, `Max P95 Latency (ms)`, `Total Requests (24h)`
29.title: Aggregated Service Performance (24h - Selected App)

30.query:
load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"
| filter in(`name`, array($SelectedApplication))
| fieldsAdd app_key = cmdb_ci_key, `Application` = name
| lookup [
    load "/lookups/cmdb_server"
    | fields app_key = busapp_cmdb_ci_key, server_name = name
    | fieldsAdd server_name_lower = lower(server_name)
    | lookup [
        fetch dt.entity.host
        | fields id, entity.name, installerVersion
        | parse entity.name, """LD:hostname ('.' LD:domain)? EOS"""
        | fieldsAdd server_name_lower = lower(hostname)
        | lookup [
            fetch events
            | filter startsWith(event.name, "OneAgentBaseline|")
            | sort timestamp desc
            | limit 1
            | fieldsAdd parts = splitString(event.name, "|")
            | fieldsAdd
                latest_version_str = arrayElement(parts, 1),
                oldest_supported_str = arrayElement(parts, 2)
            | fieldsAdd
                latest_sprint = toLong(arrayElement(splitString(latest_version_str, "."), 1)),
                oldest_sprint = toLong(arrayElement(splitString(oldest_supported_str, "."), 1))
            | fields latest_sprint, oldest_sprint
          ], sourceField:server_name_lower, lookupField:server_name_lower, fields:{latest_sprint, oldest_sprint}
        | fieldsAdd
            current_sprint = toLong(arrayElement(splitString(installerVersion, "."), 1)),
            version_status = if(current_sprint == latest_sprint, then:"Current ✅", else:if(current_sprint < oldest_sprint, then:"Unsupported ❌", else:"Outdated ⚠️")),
            agent_version = coalesce(installerVersion, "Unknown")
        | fields server_name_lower, agent_version, version_status
      ], sourceField:server_name_lower, lookupField:server_name_lower, fields:{agent_version, version_status}
  ], sourceField:app_key, lookupField:app_key, fields:{server_name, agent_version, version_status}
| filter in(`Application`, array($ApplicationName))
| fields `Application`, `Hostname` = server_name, `OneAgent Version` = agent_version, `Version Status` = version_status
| sort `Hostname` asc
30.title: OneAgent Deployment Status (Selected App)
